reason: We already pay the school fees and a tuition teacher. If the class teacher is assigning this as homework, it is part of school, so the school should pay for it, not me. I will let my child use it while it is free, but I will not pay ₹299 a month on top.
objection: The school is asking me to pay for something the teacher assigns and checks in class. It feels like a fee hike by the back door, and my tuition teacher already covers the weak topics in person.
would_change_my_mind: If the end-of-term re-test showed clear improvement that my tuition teacher had not managed, and the school folded the cost into the fees or I could drop some tuition hours because of it.
